concepts.learning_objective: Explain how 7-bit ASCII maps keyboard characters to unique codes and binary values.
Describe ISCII as an 8-bit code that retains ASCII and adds Indian language characters.
Explain why UNICODE was developed and how it relates to ASCII.
Identify the common UNICODE encodings and represent a code point in binary.

topics.title: Number Systems: Decimal, Binary, Octal and Hexadecimal

concepts.learning_objective: State the base and symbols of the decimal, binary, octal and hexadecimal number systems.
Determine the positional value of a digit in a number of any base.
Use hexadecimal notation for memory addresses and RGB colour codes.

topics.title: Conversion from Decimal to other Number Systems

concepts.learning_objective: Convert a decimal integer to binary, octal or hexadecimal by repeated division.

topics.title: Conversion from other Number Systems to Decimal

concepts.learning_objective: Convert binary, octal and hexadecimal integers to decimal using positional expansion.

topics.title: Conversion from Binary to Octal/Hexadecimal and Vice-Versa

concepts.learning_objective: Convert between binary and octal by grouping bits in threes.
Convert between binary and hexadecimal by grouping bits in fours.

topics.title: Conversion of a Number with Fractional Part

concepts.learning_objective: Convert a decimal fraction to binary by repeated multiplication by 2.
Convert numbers with fractional parts from other bases to decimal, octal or hexadecimal.
